prompt: Create an original 180 second neoclassical felt piano instrumental composition for mystery, nocturnal exploration and restrained suspense. Mood: mysterious, tense, nocturnal. Instruments: felt piano, soft cello. Style: spacious broken chords, intimate close room. Tempo approximately 54 BPM; G minor. Main idea: alternating short and long phrases. Use unresolved suspended harmony, careful space and subtle low-register movement; no jump scares. Instrumental only. No vocals, no choir, no humming, no singing, no speech, no lyrics, no vocal samples. Do not imitate any existing artist or melody. [00:00-01:00] Establish the main idea immediately with the core ensemble. [01:00-02:00] Develop the motif with a complementary instrumental counterline, preserving the intended energy. [02:00-03:00] Return to the main idea and give a musically resolved ending with a short natural tail. Finish around 03:00.

description.en: A melancholic and dramatic orchestral piece, primarily featuring a string ensemble and piano. The composition builds from a reflective opening to a more passionate and sweeping middle section, then returns to a quiet, thoughtful close. It evokes a sense of longing and introspection.
description.zh: 一首忧郁而富有戏剧性的管弦乐作品，主要由弦乐合奏和钢琴演奏。乐曲从沉思的开场逐渐发展到更具激情和宏大的中段，随后回归到安静、深思的结尾。它唤起了一种渴望和内省的感觉。
